incompatible_conditions: Missing, ambiguous, or invalid measurand units, channel semantics, or frequency-band definition.
Missing or invalid sensor/transducer or DAQ provenance, including unknown sampling rate when needed for comparability.
Missing calibration identity, valid range, or calibration uncertainty, or calibration used outside its valid range.
Unresolved operating-condition strata or missing labels that prevent the declared experimental unit or repeated-condition grouping.
Repeatability or reproducibility factors required for the claimed interpretation are absent without an explicit missing-evidence result.
An uncertainty budget is missing or contains unsupported components for the claimed interval.
Unit inconsistency, unverified conversion, or cross-dataset comparability treated as established.
Missing control definition, unresolved nuisance-factor blocking/randomization decision, or pseudo-replication risk.
Unavailable qualified specialist or facility approval for any later hazardous, destructive, human, radiation, pressure, high-voltage, biological, or regulated measurement.
required_inputs: Measurand: vibration amplitude/time-series response for each declared channel, with physical units and frequency band.
Sensor and DAQ provenance: sensor/transducer identity, channel mapping, sampling rate, acquisition path, and version/date when available.
Calibration trace: reference identity, certificate/version/date, corrections, valid range, calibration uncertainty, and applicability limits.
Operating-condition strata: speed, load, fault state, sensor position/mounting, rig geometry, record duration, and sampling rate.
Defined experimental unit and repeatability unit: an independent repeated acquisition under unchanged bearing, sensor/DAQ, mounting, and operating-condition state.
Reproducibility factors: operator, instrument/DAQ, refit or mounting, batch, site/rig, and time, with each factor marked present or missing.
Measurement model from measurand through sensor/DAQ, calibration, acquisition, processing, and reported quantity, preserving units at every stage.
Uncertainty budget with random/systematic components, distributions or bounds, correlations, calibration, resolution, drift, sampling, and model-form contributions.
Missingness ledger for absent or ambiguous units, provenance, calibration, repeatability, reproducibility, and UQ components; do not impute evidence.
Unit-consistency and frequency-band compatibility checks before any comparison.
Metric bindings: M1 measurement-metadata completeness fraction and M2 95% interval coverage for repeated-condition summaries, both in fraction [0,1].
Control definition and a declared blocking or randomization decision that preserves independent experimental units.

assumptions: The measurand is the declared vibration amplitude/time-series response; its physical unit and frequency band are record-specific and must not be inferred.
Operating range is limited to each record's declared sensor, calibration, speed, load, and fault range; no out-of-range extrapolation is assumed.
The experimental unit is an independent repeated condition-run or record; individual time samples are not independent replicates.
The response quantities are M1 measurement-metadata completeness fraction and M2 95% interval coverage for repeated-condition summaries.

Measurement-chain stability, traceability, and sensitivity to the minimum meaningful effect are hypotheses requiring checks; no empirical calibration, repeatability, reproducibility, or UQ success is assumed.
Random and systematic components and their dependence structure are either supported by evidence or explicitly marked missing before interval interpretation.
Repeatability means unchanged-condition measurement; reproducibility varies declared operator, instrument/DAQ, mounting/refit, batch/site/rig, or time factors as available.
Cross-dataset comparability and transfer remain hypothetical until target-domain decisive evidence satisfies the upstream criteria.
Any later intervention comparison must isolate the measurement-provenance, calibration, R&R, or UQ screening step; this bounded card authorizes no intervention.
baselines: Metadata-only reuse without an explicit calibration, R&R, and UQ screening step.
Do not interpret classifier accuracy or pooled signal summaries as measurement validity.
controls: Use a declared reference record or condition with its existing metadata only as a field-extraction control; it is not proof of calibration.
Block by speed, load, fault state, sensor position/mounting, and rig when available, and state any omitted factor.
Preserve independent condition-runs or records as the analysis unit; do not use time samples as replicate controls.
Preserve natural order unless a separately authorized design justifies randomization or counterbalancing; no data collection is authorized here.
failure_modes: Saturation or range violation can invalidate the measurand and reduce the defensible completeness or coverage assessment.
Drift or hysteresis can widen systematic uncertainty and reduce M2; preserve the unresolved component.
Contamination, batch effects, or mounting/refit changes can masquerade as operating-condition effects and corrupt repeatability or reproducibility.
Confounding by speed, load, fault state, sensor position, or rig can make pooled comparisons non-identifiable.
Pseudo-replication from treating time samples as independent can understate uncertainty and inflate M2.
Failed blinding or uncontrolled analysis choices can bias coverage; preserve control and analysis decisions.
Missing-not-at-random metadata or repeated-run records can bias M1 and make M2 uncomputable; report missingness.
Calibration extrapolation or unsupported model-form components can invalidate the uncertainty budget; do not claim traceability or coverage.
Cross-dataset unit, sensor-sensitivity, frequency-band, or rig mismatch can invalidate transfer; keep comparability hypothetical.
procedure_outline: Define the record-specific measurand, units, frequency band, experimental unit, and repeatability unit.
Audit existing declared sensor/DAQ provenance, operating-condition strata, and calibration trace; log missing, invalid, and out-of-range items without repair.
Separate within-condition repeatability from reproducibility across declared operator, instrument/DAQ, mounting, batch/site/rig, and time factors; emit missing-evidence status when absent.
Assess M1 and, only when supported by a declared uncertainty budget and repeated-condition summaries, M2 95% interval coverage; keep the upstream stop and pivot thresholds unchanged.
Keep this bounded outline advisory: do not collect data, download records, operate equipment, or claim calibration, repeatability, reproducibility, or UQ success.
safety_boundaries: This bounded card authorizes no equipment control, specimen handling, data collection, downloading, service, upload, deployment, or model training.

Require qualified specialist, facility, legal, ethical, and regulatory review before hazardous materials, radiation, pressure, high voltage, biological exposure, human participants, destructive testing, or regulated measurement.
Do not infer safety, calibration validity, repeatability, reproducibility, transfer, or measurement success from public records or structural validation.
Apply the stricter facility or domain boundary and keep any physical measurement or safety determination outside this card.

verified_record.title: Paderborn Bearing Dataset

verified_record.does_not_support: The large repository was not downloaded and does not establish inter-laboratory repeatability.
verified_record.supports: The official record documents accelerometers, speed/load combinations, damage severities, temperature, and endurance acquisition.
verified_record.title: The Politecnico di Torino rolling bearing test rig: description of the open-access data for vibration monitoring and diagnostics

verified_record.does_not_support: Drive-train sensor data are a bridge for provenance, not direct evidence of bearing UQ on the target rig.
verified_record.supports: The official record names ICP accelerometers, sensitivity, DAQ context, and synchronized vibration/acoustic measurements.
verified_record.title: Condition Monitoring of Drive Trains by Data Fusion of Acoustic Emission and Vibration Sensors Measurements of Vibrations and Acoustic Emissions on a Rotating Shaft

verified_record.does_not_support: A calibration-laboratory uncertainty budget is not a direct public bearing-dataset validation.
verified_record.supports: The calibration study reports traceability and expanded uncertainty across 5 Hz–10 kHz with comparison to primary standards.
verified_record.title: Measurement Uncertainty in Vibration Calibration in Frequency Range of 5 Hz to 10 kHz

verified_record.does_not_support: Its numeric limits are study-specific and are not universal acceptance thresholds.
verified_record.supports: The study separates repeatability, refit reproducibility, sensor position, frequency bands, and Gage R&R limits for rolling-bearing vibration quality control.
verified_record.title: Evaluation of the Variability of Vibration Measurement Results in Rolling Bearing Quality Control

verified_record.does_not_support: It does not quantify uncertainty for any one public dataset or justify universal limits.
verified_record.supports: The Gage R&R study makes low repeatability/reproducibility and lack of reference bearings an explicit measurement-system limitation.
verified_record.title: Application of a Gage R&R study in evaluation of rolling bearing measurement system accuracy

verified_record.does_not_support: Its narrower venue and scope do not establish a general public-data calibration protocol.
verified_record.supports: The paper applies standard uncertainty to rolling-bearing vibration time series and relates uncertainty variation to failure diameter.
verified_record.title: Standard Uncertainty of Rolling Bearing Vibration as Time Series

verified_record.does_not_support: Model-based uncertainty is not a substitute for sensor calibration or repeatability evidence.
verified_record.supports: The study estimates time-varying intervals for rolling-bearing vibration performance and checks interval coverage against a confidence level.
verified_record.title: Evaluation of Dynamic Uncertainty of Rolling Bearing Vibration Performance

verified_record.does_not_support: The application is laser Doppler vibrometry and washing-machine diagnostics rather than rolling-bearing accelerometry.
verified_record.supports: The proceedings paper evaluates feature repeatability/reproducibility and propagates uncertainty across sensor, DAQ, and processing stages.
verified_record.title: Repeatability and reproducibility of characteristic features measured by laser Doppler vibrometry for on-line diagnostics
verified_record.venue: SPIE Proceedings Eighth International Conference on Vibration Measurements by Laser Techniques: Advances and Applications

verified_record.does_not_support: Source-domain diagnostic performance does not prove measurement traceability or target-domain transfer.
verified_record.supports: Cross-domain bearing diagnosis establishes operating-condition distribution shift as a practical validation boundary.
verified_record.title: Cross-Domain Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Element Bearings Using Deep Generative Neural Networks

verified_record.does_not_support: Model uncertainty does not close physical measurement UQ prerequisites.
verified_record.supports: Uncertainty-weighted domain generalization is a method bridge for unseen bearing conditions and explicit predictive uncertainty.
verified_record.title: Uncertainty-Weighted Domain Generalization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Rolling Bearings Under Unseen Conditions
